import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, flow, cost;
        Edge(int to, int capacity, int flow, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 15000;
    static List<Edge> graphEdges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adjacency = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static long totalFlowCost = 0;
    static long[] distance = new long[MAXN];
    static int[] p = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] pe = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAXN];

    static int totalNodes, totalEdges, rebels, costParam, delay;
    static int source = 9998;
    static int sink = 9999;
    static int currentNode;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            adjacency[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void createEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cst) {
        adjacency[from].add(graphEdges.size());
        graphEdges.add(new Edge(to, cap, 0, cst));
        adjacency[to].add(graphEdges.size());
        graphEdges.add(new Edge(from, 0, 0, -cst));
    }

    static void dispatchRebels() {
        Arrays.fill(distance, 0, 10000, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(p, 0, 10000, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pe, 0, 10000, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0, 10000, 0);
        distance[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        inq[source] = 1;
        currentNode = sink;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int node = q.poll();
            inq[node] = 0;
            for (int eIdx : adjacency[node]) {
                Edge e = graphEdges.get(eIdx);
                if (e.capacity - e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cst = e.cost;
                int y = e.to;
                if (distance[y] > distance[node] + cst) {
                    distance[y] = distance[node] + cst;
                    p[y] = node;
                    pe[y] = eIdx;
                    if (inq[y] == 0) {
                        inq[y] = 1;
                        q.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int nodePtr = currentNode;
        while (nodePtr != source) {
            int eIdx = pe[nodePtr];
            graphEdges.get(eIdx).flow++;
            graphEdges.get(eIdx ^ 1).flow--;
            nodePtr = p[nodePtr];
        }
        totalFlowCost += distance[sink];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        totalNodes = sc.nextInt();
        totalEdges = sc.nextInt();
        rebels = sc.nextInt();
        costParam = sc.nextInt();
        delay = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= rebels; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            createEdge(source, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 101; i++) {
            createEdge((i - 1) * totalNodes, sink, rebels, (i - 1) * costParam);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= totalEdges; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int iTime = 1; iTime <= 100; iTime++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= rebels; j++) {
                    int costVal = delay * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1);
                    createEdge(x + (iTime - 1) * totalNodes, y + (iTime - 1) * totalNodes + totalNodes, 1, costVal);
                    createEdge(y + (iTime - 1) * totalNodes, x + (iTime - 1) * totalNodes + totalNodes, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= totalNodes; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 100; j++) {
                createEdge(i - 1 + (j - 1) * totalNodes, i - 1 + (j - 1) * totalNodes + totalNodes, rebels, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= rebels; i++) {
            dispatchRebels();
        }

        System.out.println(totalFlowCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
